title: power-reporting-v1 player output
description: The player's power-analysis field-map: detection, classification, and extracted structured fields.

has_power_analysis.description: True if the excerpt reports a power analysis.

kind.description: The kind of power analysis when present; null when has_power_analysis is false. NOTE: a post-hoc analysis worded as a-priori is still 'posthoc'.

fields.description: Extracted structured fields. Omit a field entirely if the excerpt does not report it (do not invent values).

test.description: The statistical test the analysis is for.

effect_size.description: The effect size assumed or observed.

confidence.description: Player's confidence in the has_power_analysis detection call.
